title: Patch: Duos match finish reads Jlore caps directly from the co-op payout outcome instead of a second ledger transaction
thread:
**Issue #4982 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4982: Patch: Duos match finish reads Jlore caps directly from the co-op payout outcome instead of a second ledger transaction
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
When a co-op match completes, the server will read whether the daily Jlore cap held back player payout directly from the outcome of `pay_coop` instead of opening a second database transaction to query `duos_game_jlore_caps`.

## Why
- In commit `445ccaa547` (#4711, part of the slow-app audit #4727), the end-of-match routine for 1v1 matches was measured and optimized: reading Jlore caps in a second transaction after writing the result required a new transaction begin, six store calls, and a commit (dropping 1v1 end-of-match store calls from 71 to 65). #4711 eliminated this overhead by having `MatchActor::on_record` (`crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs:1164-1182`) read `GameEconomy::jlore_capped` directly from the payout write, falling back to `game_jlore_caps` only when payout was skipped or repeated.
- Duos match completion in `crates/server/src/duos/` was overlooked and retains the exact same inefficiency:
  1. `crates/server/src/duos/mod.rs:88-103`: `finish_match` calls `pay_coop` (`crates/server/src/duos/mod.rs:147-194`), which calls `pay_game_rewards` for every seated player and returns `StoreResult<Option<[Option<GameEconomy>; 4]>>`. Each returned `GameEconomy` already contains `pub jlore_capped: bool` (`crates/shared/src/economy/rewards.rs:210`).
  2. In `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs:766-775`:
     ```rust
     let Some(economy) = self.record_result(result, at).await else {
         self.let_go("duos.result.unrecorded");
         return;
     };
     self.release_seats();
     self.lock().economy = economy;
     self.load_jlore_caps(true).await;
     ```
  3. `self.load_jlore_caps(true)` (`crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs:799-820`) calls `duos_game_jlore_caps` (`crates/server/src/duos/mod.rs:108-142`), which unconditionally opens a second transaction (`app.db.begin(None)`), reads `duos_matches_get`, deserializes `DuosResult`, and executes `economy_game_jlore_totals` for every human player (up to 4 separate queries across human seats), then commits.
- This creates 5 to 6 redundant database queries and a superfluous transaction per completed Duos match, exactly matching what #4711 eliminated for 1v1.

## Proposal
1. In `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs`:
   - Add helper `apply_jlore_caps(&self, caps: [bool; 4], announce: bool)` mirroring `MatchActor::apply_jlore_caps` in `crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs:1229-1238`.
   - In `on_record`, inspect the returned `economy: [Option<GameEconomy>; 4]`. If all seated human players were paid in the result transaction, extract `caps: [bool; 4]` from `economy[slot].as_ref().map(|e| e.jlore_capped).unwrap_or(false)` and call `self.apply_jlore_caps(caps, true)`.
   - Only fall back to `self.load_jlore_caps(true).await` when an economy was not paid (such as repeat ending or disabled economy), matching the pattern established in #4711.
2. In `crates/server/tests/store/contract.rs` or `crates/server/tests/duos.rs`, verify that completing a co-op match computes and pushes views with accurate `jlore_capped` indicators without invoking `duos_game_jlore_caps`.

## Where it lands
- `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs` (`on_record`, `load_jlore_caps`, `apply_jlore_caps`)
- `crates/server/src/duos/mod.rs` (`duos_game_jlore_caps` remains as fallback for rebuild/repeat)
- `crates/server/tests/` duos end-of-match test coverage

## Acceptance criteria
- Duos match completion delivers accurate `jlore_capped` flags in `DuosSeatMessage::View` to all human participants.
- A normal match completion skips opening a second database transaction and makes zero calls to `duos_game_jlore_caps`.
- If match economy is disabled or already recorded, fallback to `load_jlore_caps` preserves existing behavior.
- `cargo test -p jackioh-server` passes cleanly.

## Size and risks
- Size: Small. Around 30 lines of code in `crates/server/src/duos/actor.rs`.
- Risks: None. Directly follows the proven implementation from #4711 in `crates/server/src/actor/match_actor.rs`.
````
